meta.title: La Raminga · Valentina's home cooking
meta.description: Home restaurant, private chef and ready meals in Lunigiana, Italy. Seasonal, handmade dishes from the garden.

hero.title: la raminga
hero.subtitle: Seasonal, handmade cooking, told around the table with you. Pasta rolled by hand, vegetables from the garden behind the house, Italian flavours meeting scents picked up while travelling. A few seats, time for a chat. More an experience than a dinner.

about.title: Hi, I'm Valentina
about.p1: I grew up in Bergamo, traveled a lot, and now live in Lunigiana. I've worked for years as a cook and in many other jobs, but cooking is the thing that's always with me, whether I'm happy, sad, in a tent over a fire, or on holiday.
about.p2: La Raminga is how I open my home to people who want to eat well and stop for a chat. No restaurant, no big numbers, just careful dishes, a few seats, and time at the table.
about.p3: I'm vegetarian, but I cook meat and fish too: at my table you'll find everything.

cuisine.title: How I cook
cuisine.lead: Tasty, colourful, handmade. Seasonal and local whenever I can.
cuisine.body1: Everything is by hand: fresh pasta, ravioli, gnocchi, focaccia, crackers, baked desserts and crêpes. Vegetables lead the menu: wild herbs and the garden behind the house decide what goes on the table that week, alongside whatever idea I'm playing with.
cuisine.body2: I love mixing the Italian dishes I grew up with (parmigiana, pasta alla Norma, lemon risotto) with more Asian flavours: ginger, soy, grains, legumes. Once in a while I invent a themed evening: spicy dinner, vegetarian burger night, big shared plates with focaccia and fried polenta to mop up the sauce.
cuisine.body3: Vegan menus aren't a problem, gluten-free we can work out together, and I handle intolerances easily. For serious allergies though, I can't promise an allergen-free kitchen, so let me know in advance.

services.subtitle: Three ways to share a table.

items.title: Home restaurant
items.body: Come for dinner. Indoor dining room when it's cold, terrace with mountain view when the sun is out. Up to eight guests.
details: Half a litre of wine, water, coffee, amaro included
Pets welcome (let me know in advance)

items.title: Private chef
items.body: I come to you. I shop, cook, serve, wash up and tidy. You only think about your guests.

items.title: Schisete · ready meals
items.body: Ready-cooked dishes, fresh or frozen, to take home. We agree a budget and build the menu together.

garden.title: The garden
garden.p1: The vegetable garden is right behind the house, and I tend it with my neighbours. From June and July onward, the first harvest goes straight onto the plates.
garden.p2: A garden teaches you things: patience, the unexpected, insects, wind, hard work. When a vegetable goes from seed to table, the circle closes. What I don't grow myself comes from small local producers: flour from the mill nearby, eggs from neighbours.
